title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 108 West Schick Road in Bloomingdale, Illinois, as the "Bloomingdale Veterans Memorial Post Office Building".
official_summary: (Sec. 1) Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 108 West Schick Road in Bloomingdale, Illinois, as the "Bloomingdale Veterans Memorial Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a Bloomingdale, Illinois post office building the Bloomingdale Veterans Memorial Post Office Building.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives an official name to a U.S. Postal Service facility at 108 West Schick Road in Bloomingdale, Illinois. The new name is the Bloomingdale Veterans Memorial Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 24, 2018, and the naming took effect on that date.
